details.name: Ora Seaport
details.website_text: Check the real, current info on oraseaport.com
details.positions_status_help: All unit positions come from ONE fit of the website's floor plates onto the 3D model. If a few corner units match reality (e.g. on Google Maps), set this to "checked": every unit then counts as checked.
lines: Source: the website's floor plates (all 298 apartments, floors 2-11) are the authority; the 3D model only says which way each wall faces and where along it a unit is (about 3-5 ft accuracy)
Address: 899 Congress St (Ora's own address); 295-315 Northern Av (city parcel 0602681002, residential/commercial, built 2018)
Floors: 11 used here (ground floor + apartments on floors 2-11). There may be more floors: see below

notes.text: 11 floors is an assumption from the website (apartments on floors 2-11). The website's rendering shows a glass top storey, so there may be one more (amenity or penthouse) floor. Floor heights are fitted to Ora's roof in the 3D model (135 ft above sea level)
the floor plates don't show windows, so each unit's whole stretch of facade is used for its view
bedrooms and the listed sq ft are only known for the units for rent when the listing was fetched; other sizes are measured from the floor plates (approximate)
the 3D model is the whole Parcel K: Ora is the west wing, the east bar is the hotel; hotel walls have no unit data
the catalog height (154 ft) is the hotel bar's roof; Ora's roof in the 3D model is at 135 ft above sea level
the city's 3D catalog calls this model "Parcel K" (the development's name), not Ora
Google Maps and the city parcel say 295 Northern Ave; Ora uses 899 Congress St

sources: oraseaport.com availability table and floor plates (fetched 2026-11-18)
